name: The Street Comes Apart
prompt: Build a miniature working harbour in a raised inland basin. A tug parts two floating streets at their hinged joints to let a provisions barge pass, then residents draw the pavements together.

name: A Fountain Under Every House
prompt: Float compact model houses in stepped demonstration tanks in a civic water garden. Mechanics swap worn flotation chambers under one tilted house while its neighbours sit level.

name: The Laundry Regatta
prompt: Arrange washhouses on tethered pontoons in an enclosed canal court. A little boat collects hanging linen between the hulls as a floating ironing room folds the dry sheets.

name: The Buoyant Market Square
prompt: Set a floating market in a contained urban reservoir. Vendors slide ballast along a deck to level it as sacks of rice arrive; show the tilted incoming deck and a level loaded one.

name: A Town in Dry Dock
prompt: Drain one chamber of a paired model city basin. Reveal the hulls, pipes and anchors below one neighbourhood while ferries still run between the occupied houses in the full chamber.
